## 👀 Reviewer Guidelines
<!-- For reviewers -->

When reviewing this PR, please check:

1. **Code Quality**: Clean, readable, and follows project conventions
2. **Functionality**: Works as described and handles edge cases
3. **Performance**: No unnecessary re-renders or performance regressions
4. **UI/UX**: Consistent with existing design and user-friendly
5. **Data Integrity**: Game data is accurate and properly formatted (if applicable)
6. **localStorage**: User data persistence works correctly (if applicable)
7. **Documentation**: Clear comments and updated docs if needed
8. **Security**: No security vulnerabilities introduced
